name: Home & Kitchen
description: Kitchen gadgets, organisers, appliances and home accessories.

indiaFitNotes.title: Fit with Indian cooking
indiaFitNotes.detail: Check capacity and heat tolerance for Indian cooking (high-heat tadka, large vessels, grinding). Western-sized products are often too small.

indiaFitNotes.title: Wattage and sockets
indiaFitNotes.detail: Check wattage against typical Indian household circuits and that the plug and cord length suit Indian kitchens.
